proposed_comments.title: Keep fallback NT names comparable with selected paths
proposed_comments.body: file_handle_to_path normally returns a DOS path but falls back to the NT kernel name when DOS resolution fails. The selected path map only stores canonical DOS paths, so a handle that falls back to an NT name can fail to match. Store both the canonical DOS path and the kernel fallback name for selected files/directories and module paths.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve HandleInfo::kernel_file_name
proposed_comments.body: The PR description promises source compatibility, but the current head renames HandleInfo::kernel_file_name to file_path. Keep the existing field name or provide a compatibility-preserving transition.

proposed_comments.title: Keep path_to_kernel_name as a compatibility wrapper
proposed_comments.body: Renaming the public helper to path_to_canonical_name expands the change beyond implementation behavior and can break existing source users. Retain path_to_kernel_name as a wrapper while adding the canonical helper.

proposed_comments.title: Add regression coverage for canonical DOS paths
proposed_comments.body: Add a focused test that exercises the new canonical path helper on a real temporary file and asserts the result has a DOS/UNC shape rather than accepting the NT fallback path.
